entities.name: StorageKeysModule
observations: 2026-06-07: Central localStorage key registry at src/lib/storage-keys.ts. Convention: resumsify:<feature>:<key> (colon-separated app namespace + feature group + kebab-case key). Replaces ad-hoc kebab keys like 'sidebar-collapsed' / 'docs-view' / 'worklog-rail-*'.
2026-06-07: STORAGE_KEYS object groups every key under a feature ({ sidebar:{}, worklog:{}, documents:{} }). New keys MUST be added there — never hard-code the literal in components.

2026-06-07: migrateLegacyKey(newKey) is a lazy one-time migrator. Call it from the same useEffect that does the first read. Idempotent and best-effort — silently no-ops in private mode / quota errors. LEGACY_KEY_MAP is the rename ledger; renames register an entry there to keep user state across releases.

2026-06-07: Out-of-scope (not migrated this pass): ai-chat 'resumsify-ai-*' and gallery-modal 'gallery-settings'. They already use a prefix; merging into the central registry is a separate audit pass when those features are next touched.
